# KaTeX 0.16.22

This directory vendors the unmodified browser distribution of KaTeX 0.16.22:
`katex.min.js`, `katex.min.css`, and the referenced fonts.

Source: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/releases/tag/v0.16.22

The files were copied from the locally installed VS Code KaTeX package.
The MIT license is preserved in `LICENSE`. No CDN, package installation or
build step is required to render equations.
